brand.title: Your organization's look
brand.hint: Your members see this name and logo instead of Darsi's: at the top of every screen, on their certificates and in the browser tab.
brand.name: Organization name
brand.logoHint: A square logo works best. It is made small on this device (256 px, under 100 KB) before it is sent, so members' phones download it once and quickly.
brand.saved: Saved. Members see it the next time they open Darsi.
brand.notImage: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
brand.unreadable: This image couldn't be read. Try a PNG, JPEG or WebP file.
brand.tooBig: This image could not be made small enough. Try a simpler logo.
an.title: Analytics
an.updated: Accounts and organizations counted {when}. Usage counts arrive as phones send them.
an.never: Not counted yet. Press Refresh now.
an.usage: {offline} of activity happened offline. {installed} of visits came from the installed app. Courses downloaded: {downloads} ({mb} MB).
an.noData: Nothing yet in the last 30 days.
an.searchName: Search by name, email or username
an.searchHint: The account with that exact email or username, and names that start with what you typed. Capital letters count, except the first.
an.gaOn: On: every batch phones send also goes to Google Analytics, with no names or emails.
an.gaOff: Off: Darsi counts usage itself, but nothing goes to Google Analytics yet.
an.gaHint: The measurement ID is the Firebase web app's (G-…). Make the API secret in Google Analytics: Admin, Data streams, the web stream, Measurement Protocol API secrets, Create.
an.gaSaved: Saved. Phones' next batches go to Google Analytics within 10 minutes.
an.gaBadId: A measurement ID looks like G-ABC123XYZ.
or.title: Learning report
or.nobody: No one matches these filters yet.
or.statusHint: Needs support: an average score under 60% over 3 lessons or more. Inactive: nothing for 14 days. Choose one to see those people below.
or.crosswalk: Darsi's mapping of its lessons to this framework, not an official alignment.
or.direct: Lessons are tagged with these competencies.
or.openHint: Every student and teacher against UNESCO, DigComp, ISTE and CSTA, by class and course, with an Excel export.
or.noCourses: No one has started a course yet.
or.teachersHint: Each teacher's own learning (UNESCO framework for teachers) beside their students'.
inv.shortCode: This code is the old, shorter kind. Make a new one for a longer, safer code; the old one stops working at once.
inv.teacherWarn: Anyone with the teacher code joins as a teacher. Share it only with your teachers.
inv.newConfirmTeacher: Make a new teacher code? The old code and its links stop working.
inv.newConfirmStudent: Make a new student code? The old code and its links stop working.
inv.newDone: New code made. The old one no longer works.
adm.noCoverage: No one has evidence for a competency yet.
adm.bulkHint: Tick people in the table to give them a class or a teacher together.
adm.bulkNoStudents: Only students have a teacher, and none of the people you selected is a student.
p.coursesFailed: Some courses didn't load. Check the connection and try again.
imp.interrupted: The connection dropped after {done} of {total}. Download these logins now, then try the rest again.
add.warn.teacher: Teacher not found: no teacher assigned
add.err.invalidUsername: Use {min} to {max} Latin letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
add.err.exists: This email already has a Darsi account: send them your invite link instead.
add.err.taken: Choose another username, or leave it empty and Darsi makes one.
imp.madeBefore: Made before the connection dropped: reset the password on their page
slip.keep: Keep this slip safe: it has your password.
p.notYours: This person isn't one of your students. Their teacher may have changed.
p.notMember: This person isn't in your organization.
p.reviewFailed: The review wasn't saved. Reload the page and try again.
po.title: Organizations
po.adminHint: The email or username of an existing account. They become this organization's admin.
po.adminNotFound: No single account matches that email or username.
po.adminSelf: You can't make yourself an organization's admin: you would stop being a platform admin.
po.adminIsSuper: That person is a platform admin. Change their role on their page first.
acc.title: Account and data
acc.hint: For a request from the person, a parent or their school: their data as a file, or the account deleted with everything in it.
acc.deleteBody: This deletes {name}'s account and their lessons, notes, projects and files for good. Payment records stay, without their name.
acc.notYours: Only a platform admin, or the admin of the organization that made the account, can do that.
acc.renewing: Their Darsi Super subscription renews by itself: its renewal must be turned off first.
acc.suspended: Suspended: they can't sign in, and their sessions have ended.
acc.restored: Restored: they can sign in again.
mod.confirm: Remove this project's text, links and files for good? Its review stays.
po.addHint: Find any account by email, username or the start of their name. Someone in another organization moves here.
po.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from this organization? They are signed out on every device, lose their class and teacher, and become an independent learner.
po.demoteConfirm: Change {name}'s role to {role}? They stop being an admin of this organization and are signed out on every device.
po.lastAdmin: This is the organization's only admin. Make someone else its admin first.
po.deleteHint: Its members become independent learners and keep their learning. Its invite codes stop working, and its own courses, logo and files are deleted. This can't be undone.
po.deletedOrg: {name} was deleted. Its members are now independent learners.
po.notSelf: You can't change your own role. Another platform admin can.
po.superHint: A platform admin can see and change everything on Darsi.
po.orgHint: Students, teachers and organization admins belong to one organization.
po.learnerHint: An independent learner belongs to no organization.
po.roleSaved: Saved. They see the change the next time they open Darsi.
sp.title: Darsi Super plans
sp.intro: What people and organizations can buy. Saving publishes the active plans to the Super screen. Prices are what Paymob (EGP) and Stripe (USD) charge.
aw.projectsIntro: Projects learners submitted, in every organization and outside them. Review them here as their teachers would.
aw.certsIntro: Everyone who finished a course, from their progress. Open one to see the certificate as the learner does.
aw.noCerts: Nobody has finished a course yet.
sp.switchOn: On: people see Super, the tutor answers, and plans can be bought.
sp.switchOff: Off: Super is hidden everywhere, the tutor doesn't answer and nothing can be bought. Subscriptions and credits are kept, so turning it on again gives everyone back what they had.
sp.turnedOn: Darsi Super is on for everyone.
sp.turnedOff: Darsi Super is off for everyone.
sp.capOn: On: each milestone a learner sends gets an advisory AI review, within the limits below. A person still decides.
sp.capOff: Off: milestones still go to a teacher or the Darsi team, without an AI review.
sp.capTurnedOn: AI reviews of capstone milestones are on.
sp.capTurnedOff: AI reviews of capstone milestones are off.
sp.capPerDay: AI reviews per learner a day
sp.capMaxPerDay: AI reviews for the whole platform a day
sp.capCallsPerDay: Milestones one learner may send a day
sp.capToday: AI reviews today: {n} (cost at the provider: {usd}).
sp.capSaved: Saved. The next milestone sent follows the new limits.
sp.idHint: 3–32 of a–z, 0–9 and _ (e.g. super_monthly). Keep it once people have bought it.
sp.checkHint: Builds the purchase Google Analytics will get for this plan and sends it to Google's validation server, which records nothing.
sp.gaOk: Google Analytics accepts the purchase event.
sp.gaOff: Google Analytics isn't connected yet: add the measurement ID and API secret on the Analytics page.
sp.grantHint: Complimentary: added to any time they already have, and never counted as revenue.
sp.licenceHint: For an organization that pays by invoice. A licence bought online is set by the payment itself.
sp.filled: Free seats given: teachers first, then students.
sp.seatSearch: Find a member (name, username or class)
led.title: Records
led.hint: Who changed what (roles, organizations, courses, Super and credits, refunds), and every payment. A list is read only when you open it, 50 at a time, newest first.
an.capstoneLine: Milestones sent: {calls}, cost at the provider: {usd}
sp.ecoHint: What one tutor credit costs Darsi at the AI provider, and the EGP rate. The tutor charges credits at each call's measured cost, so these decide the margin: every price must keep at least 60% after its credits' cost.
sp.err.ecoCost: The cost of one credit (USD) must be above 0 and at most {max}.
sp.err.ecoRate: The EGP rate must be from {min} to {max} EGP for 1 USD.
sp.err.planId: Plan {n}: the id needs 3–32 of a–z, 0–9 and _.
sp.err.planTwice: Plan {n}: the id {id} is used twice.
sp.err.planName: Plan {id}: give it a name in English and in Arabic.
sp.err.planPrice: Plan {id}: the {cur} price must be a positive number.
sp.err.planNoPrice: Plan {id}: give it a price in EGP or USD.
sp.err.planCredits: Plan {id}: credits must be from 0 to {max}.
sp.err.packCredits: Plan {id}: a credit pack needs credits.
sp.err.planMargin: Plan {id}: the {cur} price leaves a {pct} margin after its credits' cost. It must keep at least {least}.
sp.balance: Tutor credits: {plan} left this period, {packs} in packs.
sp.revokeConfirm: Take Darsi Super back from this person now?
sp.revokePaid: It is a paid {provider} subscription: taking it back doesn't refund it or stop {provider} charging.
sp.removeConfirm: Remove the licence? Everyone using its seats loses Darsi Super now, and a licence bought online isn't refunded.
sp.licenceEnded: Your organization's Darsi Super licence ended on {date}.
acct.claimed: More than one account gives this email, so none was picked. Check them in the Firebase console first.
acct.ownLogin: This person signs in with their own email or Google account, so only they can change its password. Ask them to use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.
bg.title: Problem reports
bg.intro: What people sent with Report a problem, newest first: their words, a picture of their screen and the details their device sent (browser, screen, connection, recent errors).
bg.noErrors: No errors were recorded before the report.
bg.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the text in All details instead.
rf.selfRole: You can't change your own role. Another admin can.
rf.selfRemove: You can't remove yourself from the organization. Another admin can.
rf.selfPassword: Change your own password on the sign-in page, with “Forgot password”.
rf.notMember: This person is no longer in this organization. Refresh the page.
rf.notOrgAdmin: Only this organization's admins can do that.
rf.notSuper: Only platform admins can do that.
rf.badRole: Choose a role from the list.
rf.noOrg: That organization wasn't found. Choose one from the list.
rf.orgName: The organization's name needs 2 characters or more.
rf.confirmName: Type the organization's name exactly as it is shown.
rf.batchSize: Send between 1 and 500 people at a time.
p.self: This is your own account. Another admin can change your role, reset your password or remove you.
p.removeAsk: Remove {name} from the organization? They are signed out on every device and lose their class and teacher. Their learning record stays with them.
or.noWeekly: No lessons finished in these 12 weeks.
brand.hintOther: Its members see this name and logo instead of Darsi's: at the top of every screen, on their certificates and in the browser tab.
